outgoing.name: Photography
outgoing.excerpt: Hiking, photography, and camping are very popular in the park.

outgoing.name: United States
outgoing.excerpt: Mount Rainier is a composite volcano in Pierce County, Washington, located 54 miles (87 km) southeast of Seattle, Washington, in the United States.

outgoing.name: William McKinley
outgoing.excerpt: On March 2, 1899, President William McKinley established Mount Rainier National Park as America's fifth national park.
